color-system.twistDescription: Copied verbatim — no modification. sprig-ledger chosen for light register (pageBackground #ffffff, luminance 255).

type-system.twistDescription: Elevated display scale to 96px Playfair Display italic (from 72px upright). Added Dancing Script as editorial/caption voice for botanical labels. All fonts validated against known-google-fonts.md and converted to CDN imports. Italic forced on Playfair Display as primary aesthetic posture.

motion-system.twistDescription: Replaced all generic easing with Art Nouveau organic vocabulary: vineGrow (SVG stroke-dashoffset), petalUnfurl (scale+rotate with organic bounce), tendrilRise (translateY+rotation), goldShimmer (infinite opacity+scale oscillation), revealSweep (clip-path left-to-right). Introduced organic-bounce easing cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) for botanical elements.

grid-system.twistDescription: Renamed all layout utilities to salon-* vocabulary (salon-full, salon-feature, salon-narrow, salon-split, salon-wide, salon-framed). Added decorative gold divider on salon-split. salon-framed adds Art Nouveau corner flourishes via CSS pseudo-elements. Max-width elevated to 1600px (grand salon scale).

spacing-system.twistDescription: Grand maximalist spacing — lavish breathing room as design principle. Hero 192px vertical (theatrical entrance). Section padding 128px (generous frame around every content zone). Container h-padding 64px. Grid gap 36px (matches 28px gutter + 8px additional air). Nav 22px block. CTA 14px/28px.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Organic ease (0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94) slows all interactions to 0.6s. Buttons lift with gold warmth box-shadow. Underline reveals use drawn-in gold hairline (background-size 0→100%). Ghost buttons fill with gold on hover. No instant state changes — every interaction breathes.

nav-system.twistDescription: Height 76px (generous). Cormorant Garamond 0.9rem replaces source sans — Art Nouveau register. Starts transparent over hero, gains frosted white + gold hairline border on scroll. Logo uses Playfair Display italic.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Shifted concept register to luxury textile atelier (Atelier Botanica) with Art Nouveau botanical craft identity. Tone shifted to more material and sensory — indigo vats, loom weave, pressed specimens. concept_by_video.md introduces 3 video placements: hand-dye-process.mp4 (hero), loom-weave-rhythm.mp4 (craft feature), botanical-studio.mp4 (editorial).

B_motionInteractionCoherence.detail: Motion durations 0.75–0.91s (organic), interaction transitions 0.6s. Ratio 1.25–1.5× — within 5× threshold. Coherent: both systems share organic ease philosophy.

C_navFontAvailability.detail: nav.json fontFamily 'Cormorant Garamond' — present in type-system typography.json cssVars (--ds-font-family-subheading). PASS.
